params.prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Tasteful 1980s computing identity. Crisp pixel-grid symbol depicting a device snapped into a dock, with a clever capital B silhouette. Deliberate stair-step edges, limited shapes, authentic 8-bit geometry without game scenery. Dark charcoal #22262A and phosphor green #43BC7C. Distinct custom pixel-font Berth wordmark with excellent legibility.
